messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a staged deploy tonight across runtime, router, API, and console during the 00:00-02:00 UTC window. Need agreement on pin order, canary %, and rollback triggers. :wave:
chris: I propose runtime -> router -> api -> console. Runtime has the kernel batching change that needs to land first.
jordan: +1 on that order. Router header split depends on runtime kv-change, so router after runtime.
ashley: Console doesn't have schema changes; can roll last. I'll validate migrations are noop.
kevin: Monitoring owners? I can own SLO dashboards and alerts for the window. Who's on-call for rollback?
maria: @chris you own rollback decision for runtime and router, @kevin owns API/console. We'll escalate to pager if >3% 5xx or P95 latency >500ms sustained for 5m.
chris: Ack. Rollback criteria: (1) p50 ok but p95 >500ms for 5m; (2) >3% 5xx across region; (3) canary error spike >1% within first 15m.
jordan: Canary plan: 2 waves — 5% for 10m, then 30% for 20m, then full. If second wave error rate >0.5% revert.
maria: Pinning: let's pin API to `api@v1.12.3`, runtime to `runtime@v2.3.1-kbatch`, router to `router@v0.9.0-split`, console to `console@release-7`. Runbook snippet:```deploybot pin api=api@v1.12.3 runtime=runtime@v2.3.1-kbatch router=router@v0.9.0-split console=console@release-7```
deploy-bot: Scheduled pin command accepted. Maintenance window: 2026-03-21T00:00Z - 2026-03-21T02:00Z.
ashley: Release notes for console: small UI tweak, no DB migration. I'll push to release-notes repo now.
kevin: Alert thresholds already configured in the dashboard but I'll add a temporary guard: additional alert if token-processing latency changes >20%.
chris: Quick preflight checklist: infra capacity verified, canary infra warm, rollback script ready:```./scripts/rollback_wave.sh --service runtime --target previous```. All set on my side.
maria: OK schedule looks good. Last call for objections? :eyes:
jordan: No objections. :thumbsup:
ashley: No objections. I'll be monitoring console logs during rollout.
kevin: I'll watch request rates and errors, will ping if anything weird.
deploy-bot: Starting wave 1 (5%) for runtime at 2026-03-21T00:05Z. Canary window 10m.
chris: Watching runtime canary logs. No errors so far. p95 steady ~120ms. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Wave 1 complete. Proceeding to wave 2 (30%) for runtime at 2026-03-21T00:20Z.
chris: Wave 2 healthy. No error spikes. Proceeding to router canary 5%.
jordan: Router wave 1 (5%) started. header-split active on 5% of traffic.
deploy-bot: Router wave 1 complete. No 5xx. Proceeding to Router wave 2 (30%).
jordan: Router wave 2 healthy. Metrics look nominal. Moving to API canary 5%.
kevin: API 5% started. Watching for 4xx/5xx change.
maria: Reminder: rollback trigger for API is >3% 5xx OR p95 >500ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: API wave 1 complete. Metrics: 5xx 0.18%, p95 210ms. Proceeding to API wave 2 (30%).
kevin: API wave 2 fine. No anomalous traces.
ashley: Console deploy starting to 10% now. No DB migrations.
deploy-bot: Console wave 1 complete. No issues. Proceeding to full rollout for all services at 2026-03-21T01:10Z.
maria: Great work team. Final notes — update release-notes with exact pinned versions and call out kernel batching change. I'll close the window after 01:50 if no regressions.
kevin: Will audit logs for token-level cost impact and surface any anomalies.
chris: If we need emergency rollback, use the rollback script and notify #incidents.
maria: End of thread — will post post-release summary in 30m. :tada:
